label: Lab 02
title: Every brain on the same tasks
question: Can a small model on your own machine do real agent tasks as well as the cloud models?
how: Hand-written rules, small local models and cloud models play the same seeded tasks. We write down what we expect before each run, then count, with an interval on every result and every caveat stated.
